{{Current events header|2015|05|7}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko  Haram]]
**At least five people are killed in a [[Boko Haram]] attack on a village in southwest [[Niger]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/2015/05/07/us-nigeria-violence-niger-idUSKBN0NS28B20150507 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*Archaeologists in [[Madagascar]] announce the partial discovery of [[William Kidd|Captain Kidd]]'s treasure. A silver ingot was found in a wreck off the coast of [[Île Sainte-Marie]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-32621444 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Scores of flights are cancelled after a fire devastates part of terminal three at [[Rome|Rome's]] [[Fiumicino Airport]]. The fire was triggered by an electrical fault. [http://www.news24.com/news24/World/News/Rome-airport-in-chaos-after-fire-20150507 (AFP via News24)]
*The wreck of the migrant boat which sank in April 2015 with 700 people on board is located by the [[Italian Navy]] 136km off the [[Libya]]n coast at a depth of 375m. [http://www.news24.com/news24/World/News/Italian-navy-finds-migrant-disaster-boat-20150507 (AFP via News24)]
*The [[Royal Navy]]'s [[HMS Bulwark]] rescues 110 migrants from a dinghy off the coast of [[Libya]], the first for a British ship during 2015. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-32626560 (BBC)]

;International relations
*The [[United States Senate]] passes a bill giving the Congress a voice in any nuclear deal negotiated between [[Iran]] and world powers. [http://www.nytimes.com/2015/05/08/us/politics/iran-bill-republicans.html (''New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*The [[United States Court of Appeal]] rules that the [[National Security Agency]]'s mass surveillance of telephones [[metadata]] is illegal under the [[Patriot Act]]. [http://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2015/may/07/nsa-phone-records-program-illegal-court (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[United Kingdom general election, 2015]]
**Voters in the [[United Kingdom]] go to the polls for a general election with [[exit poll]]s indicating that the [[Conservative Party (United Kingdom)|Conservative Party]] likely to be the largest party in the [[United Kingdom House of Commons|House of Commons]] after the election. [http://www.theguardian.com/politics/2015/may/06/general-election-2015-britain-heading-for-hung-parliament (''The Guardian'')] [http://www.bbc.com/news/election-2015-32618577 (BBC)], [http://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/general-election-2015/11586490/results-live.html (''The Telegraph'')]
